## Live Law

@ LiveLawIndia#SupremeCourt to hear today the petitions seeking independent
investigation into the #Tirupati Temple Laddu issue.

A bench of Justices BR Gavai and KV Viswanathan will hear at 10. 30 AM.

Solicitor General was asked to convey the Centre's stand on the need for a Central
probe.

1. #Sr Advs Mukul Rohatgi, Siddharth Luthra and SG Tushar Mehta present
2. Hearing to begin shortly
3. SG: I examined the issue. One thing is clear. If there is any element of truth in this
4. allegation, it's unacceptable. Devotees are all over the country. Food safety also there.
5. I did not find against members of SIT
6. SG: Let SIT be supervised by some senior central official. It would inspire
7. confidence
8. J Gavai: We read in the newspaper, that Hon'ble CM has no objection if the
9. investigation is conducted by...
10. Rohatgi: We wish to go with SIT. Your Lordships may add any officer of your choice.
11. Govt, keeping in view sentiments, registered FIR. We don't go by newspapers
12. Sr Adv Kapil Sibal (for petitioners): Yesterday another statement was made...it
13. would be in fitness of things if your Lordships have independent investigation. Had he
14. not made the statement, it would have been another matter. It has an impact
15. Rohatgi (for Andhra Pradesh): Reports from NDTV are from July. It's not as if CM
16. said something before report
17. came...what is portrayed is something out of context. It was 100 days of
18. completion...
19. Luthra: We have discovered now that these goods were not even supplied by
20. original manufacturer. I have gone through the lab report now more meticulously.
21. J Viswanathan: The law says we can always have an Amicus
22. J Gavai: Nobody doubts it's a very serious matter if there is substance in
23. allegations
24. Rohatgi: There is no gag order
25. Sibal: How does he say lard was used?
26. 9 . Sibal: That's vegetable fat. It was found earlier also. Your Lordships may have an
27. independent...
28. J Viswanathan: Mr Luthra, TTD present chairman is on record saying these were
29. not used
30. J Viswanathan: You are presuming based on 6th...
31. Luthra (for TTD): What reached the hill on 6th and 12 was contaminated

text:
Sibal: Why did you allow it?

J Gavai: Testing would have been done on hill only

1. SG: This is about faith of devotees
2. J Gavai: We suggest independent SIT. It can have 2 from CBI, 2 from State govt,
3. and 1 from FSSAI. Can keep
4. matter pending.
5. J Gavai: FSSAI because they are most expert apex body, in matters of testing food
6. Sibal: Very fair. Nobody can object to that.
7. J Gavai: We don't want this to turn into political drama. If there is independent
8. body, there will be confidence.
9. J Gavai: Both are warring groups...lakhs of devotees' faith involved
10. Rohatgi: Your lordships may pass that order
11. Sr Adv Rajshekhar Rao (for petitioners): No objection.
12. J Gavai (dictating): These petitions have been filed seeking reliefs including a
13. direction for constituting a Committee...for the purpose of look into allegations against
14. manufacturer and trust
15. J Gavai: FIR is registered, alleging therein that the ghee received in 4 tankers
16. supplied on...by the same supplier...found the ghee to be adulterated. It is alleged that
17. adulterated ghee was used in manufacture of prasadam
18. J Gavai: Allegation has potential of hurting sentiments of people worldwide. On
19. last date, we had asked SG to take instructions. Shri Mehta, on instructions, stated
20. that he has found out about credentials of SIT members and all of them ...
21. J Gavai: ... have good reputation. He submits that SIT can continue however court
22. may add a central officer. We clarify that we have not gone into allegations and
23. counter-allegations. We will not permit the court to be used as political background
24. J Gavai: In order to assuage...We find that investigation should be conducted by
25. an independent SIT, consisting of reps of state police, CBI and FSSAI. It would also
26. be apt if investigation is carried under director of CBI.
27. J Gavai: We are passing this order...considering feelings of crores of people
28. having faith in the deity. We direct the SIT to have:
29. (1) 2 officers of CBI nominated by Director
30. (2) 2 officers of AP state police
31. (3) 1 senior officer of FSSAI
32. J Gavai: FSSAI rep shall be nominated by Chairperson, FSSAI
33. Petitions disposed of.
